diagnosis: Mid-cycle upgrade to Business on the 14th triggers proration on the first invoice per kb-0001, so the combined invoice differs from list price. No dispute indicators present.
reply: Thank you for reaching out about invoice INV-88213. Because your upgrade to the Business plan happened mid billing cycle, we prorate the remaining days on your previous plan and issue a combined invoice. On that first invoice you'll see a proration credit for the unused portion of the old plan followed by a charge for the new plan, so the total can differ from the plan price shown on our pricing page for the first invoice only. Subsequent invoices should reflect the standard plan price.
